# Kovan

> Shared USDC budgets AI agents can't overspend. An owner locks USDC in a pool on Stellar testnet; each agent gets a smart account bound by an on-chain covenant (allowed payees, per-payment and total caps, expiry). Agents prepare transactions with kovan.mjs; owners approve in Freighter.

Stellar testnet only. Not audited.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://kovan-protocol.vercel.app/docs): What Kovan is, how the pieces fit, and where to start.
- [Quickstart](https://kovan-protocol.vercel.app/docs/quickstart): From zero to a funded pool and an agent that pays inside its limits.
- [Concepts](https://kovan-protocol.vercel.app/docs/concepts): Pools, agent wallets, covenants, the lifecycle, delegation and the guarantees.
- [Agent tool](https://kovan-protocol.vercel.app/docs/agent-tool): kovan.mjs, the one-file tool agents use to set up pools and agents and to spend.
- [SDK](https://kovan-protocol.vercel.app/docs/sdk): @kovan/sdk: create pools and agents, and sign agent payments from TypeScript.
- [Contracts](https://kovan-protocol.vercel.app/docs/contracts): Deployed testnet IDs, pool functions, events and every error code.
- [Paying with x402](https://kovan-protocol.vercel.app/docs/x402): How a covenant-bound smart account pays per call over x402.
- [Security model](https://kovan-protocol.vercel.app/docs/security): What Kovan enforces on-chain, what you trust, and what it does not cover.

## For agents

- [Agent guide (skill)](https://kovan-protocol.vercel.app/agent.md): rules and step-by-step recipes for agents
- [kovan.mjs](https://kovan-protocol.vercel.app/kovan.mjs): the one-file agent tool (Node 20+)
- [Signing page](https://kovan-protocol.vercel.app/sign): for agents that can't serve a local approval page
- [Deployment record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kovan-protocol/kovan/main/deployments/testnet.json): contract IDs and code hashes
